zh: 港金管局與杜拜金融局建工作組
聯同港交所及納斯達克杜拜合作
旨在加強雙方資本市場聯動
work.en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority, HKEX, Dubai Financial Services Authority, and Nasdaq Dubai have established a Strategic Working Group. The cross-border initiative is aimed at deepening financial ties and collaboration across both capital markets.

zh: 港銀推高達六厘活期存款吸客
相關優惠多屬漸進式加息機制
存戶須留意獲取最高利率之條款
work.en: Hong Kong banks are drawing customer funds with savings deposit rates reaching as high as 6%. However, depositors need to note that these promotional yields are tiered under progressive interest rate structures rather than flat rates.

zh: 月之暗面澄清上市相關傳聞
否認計劃於香港及上海雙重上市
公司近期受資本市場高度關注
work.en: Chinese AI startup Moonshot AI has publicly dismissed media speculation regarding an initial public offering. The company denied reports that it was preparing for a dual listing across Hong Kong and Shanghai.

smalltalk_hk.headline: Haitian Flavouring Completes Acquisition of Amoy Food
smalltalk_hk.body: Mainland condiment giant Foshan Haitian Flavouring & Food has officially finalized its full buyout of century-old Hong Kong brand Amoy Food from Trustar Capital. The Chinese maker plans to use the storied local brand to spearhead and accelerate its global market expansion.

smalltalk_hk.headline: China SAMR Clears Anta Sports to Acquire Puma Stake
smalltalk_hk.body: China's State Administration for Market Regulation has granted antitrust clearance for Anta Sports to acquire a major controlling stake in Puma. The transaction is valued at approximately 1.5 billion euros.

smalltalk_hk.headline: JD.com Remedies for Ceconomy Deal Draw Competitor Pushback
smalltalk_hk.body: Remedies submitted by JD.com to clear its proposed takeover of European consumer electronics retailer Ceconomy have faced criticism from industry rivals, according to Reuters. Regulators are assessing whether the concessions sufficiently address market competition concerns.

smalltalk_sg.headline: Power Bank Catches Fire at Little India MRT Station
smalltalk_sg.body: A power bank caught fire at Little India MRT station, prompting an immediate response from station personnel who extinguished the blaze on site. The incident caused brief concern among commuters but resulted in no reported casualties.

smalltalk_sg.headline: Gemini Secures Full Major Payment Institution Licence in Singapore
smalltalk_sg.body: Cryptocurrency exchange Gemini has been granted a full Major Payment Institution license by the Monetary Authority of Singapore. The approval allows the firm to scale up its digital payment token and cross-border transfer services across the region.

smalltalk_sg.headline: Singapore Pilots Cross-Bank AI System to Curb Scam Accounts
smalltalk_sg.body: Singapore lenders have begun testing a collaborative cross-bank artificial intelligence system designed to detect and flag mule and scam accounts in near real time. The initiative aims to disrupt illicit fund transfers before stolen capital can be withdrawn.

personal_hk.headline: 沙田圍呂明才小學39人疑食物中毒 下周一起取消現場午膳分份
personal_hk.body:
浸信會沙田圍呂明才小學37名學童及2名職員食午膳滷水雞髀和長通粉後不適，食安中心已勒令飯商停業消毒。
校方通告宣布下周一起取消現場分份午膳，全面改派獨立飯盒。

personal_hk.headline: 周一鳴：香港警察學院日後可頒授學士學位 預期今年底正式開始
personal_hk.body:
警務處處長周一鳴透露警察學院獲評審局批准頒授學位，屬首個合資格政府部門。
未獲學位的員佐級警員預計今年底起可報讀免費課程，進修3至4年取得安保及刑事調查榮譽學士。

personal_hk.headline: 第二十屆香港藝術發展獎9月16日起公開接受申請
personal_hk.body: 第二十屆香港藝術發展獎將於9月16日起公開接受申請，部分核心獎項獎金更獲倍增。

personal_sg.headline: PM Lawrence Wong Addresses Ministerial Salary Increases
personal_sg.body:
Prime Minister Lawrence Wong stated that salary adjustments for political office holders are not about himself or the PAP government, but rather Singapore's future governance.
He thanked Members of Parliament for their participation in the wage debate following public discussion over minister pay adjustments.

personal_sg.headline: Malaysian Politician Syed Saddiq Invites Health Minister Ong Ye Kung to Wedding
personal_sg.body:
Malaysian Member of Parliament Syed Saddiq Abdul Rahman has extended an invitation to Singapore Health Minister Ong Ye Kung for his upcoming October wedding.
Syed Saddiq quipped that the invitation represented upgrading bilateral relations between the two countries to wedding status.

personal_sg.headline: PM Lawrence Wong Speaks at Singapore Kadayanallur Muslim League Dinner
personal_sg.body: Prime Minister Lawrence Wong attended and delivered an address at the 85th Anniversary Dinner of the Singapore Kadayanallur Muslim League.
